entities.name: Kolevi
entities.description: Kolevi of Havenwood, an elderly Elder Druid of Havenwood who shared the secret of Thelon's thallid success with Lalani.

entities.name: Lalani
entities.description: An Elder Druid and Kolevi's lover.

entities.name: Thelon
entities.description: A druid whose thallids were made in part from thrulls of the Ebon Hand.

entities.name: Ebon Hand
entities.description: The order that traded thrulls to Havenwood.

entities.name: Reod Dai
entities.description: Ordered by the Havenwood druids to set up raids in southern Icatia.

entities.name: Havenwood
entities.description: The place where Kolevi was an Elder Druid.

entities.name: Icatia
entities.description: The land the Havenwood druids sought to distract.

events.summary: Kolevi and Lalani share the secret that Thelon's thallids were made in part from thrulls obtained through trade with the Ebon Hand.
events.quote: they were made in part from thrulls from the Ebon Hand

events.summary: The Havenwood druids order Reod Dai to set up raids in southern Icatia to distract it from the illicit trade.
events.quote: the Havenwood druids had ordered Reod Dai to set up raids

relations.note: His lover and fellow Elder Druid.
relations.quote: his lover, fellow Elder Druid Lalani
